# Bloody Dave's Fishing Planner — LLM Data Access

Use the public, keyless briefing endpoints below. They resolve built-in spots, worldwide place names, or direct latitude/longitude, fetch live Open-Meteo weather and marine data, and return an LLM-readable briefing.

Human-readable Markdown:
https://weather.bloodydaves.com/brief?spot=freo&days=5

Structured JSON:
https://weather.bloodydaves.com/brief.json?spot=freo&days=5

Location parameters:
- `spot=freo` or `spot=johnny` selects a built-in reference spot.
- `place=Broome%20WA` resolves a worldwide place name.
- `name=My%20Reef&lat=-32.0600&lon=115.6500` uses direct coordinates and labels the result.

Window parameters:
- `mode=wind&maxWind=5&minHours=3` finds the next continuous three-hour wind window at or below 5 knots; add `daylight=true` if you only want daylight.
- `vessel=sl20|tinnie|offshore|kayak` uses a built-in boating profile.
- `minHours=3`, `daylight=true`, `minStars=4`, `maxSwell=1`, and `maxChop=0.65` further tune vessel-style queries.

Example: https://weather.bloodydaves.com/brief?place=Fremantle&mode=wind&maxWind=5&minHours=3&days=7

Golden Window defaults: daylight, wind at or below 10 kt, swell below 1.0 m, zero rain chance, 4★+ fishing, and a minimum three consecutive hours. SL20 wind bands are Go below 15 kt, Marginal from 15–20 kt, and Avoid above 20 kt; short-period swell and wind chop can downgrade the wind band, while clean long-period swell is discounted.

Forecast scores are planning aids only. Always check official marine warnings, local conditions, and vessel limits.
